user.title: HAVAG line
user.description: Search for your stop, then name the line and (optionally) a direction.

data.direction: Direction (part of the destination name, optional)

error.cannot_connect: The timetable service could not be reached.
error.no_results: No stop found with that name.

abort.already_configured: This stop, line and direction is already set up.

get_departure.name: Get departure
get_departure.description: Returns the status of the next departure of the configured line as a result for use in automations. With an offset it is the first departure predicted at least that many minutes from now, so a late tram that was planned earlier still counts and a tram that has already left does not.

config_entry_id.name: Line
config_entry_id.description: Which configured line to use. Only needed when several are set up.

offset_minutes.name: Offset
offset_minutes.description: Only consider departures predicted at least this many minutes from now (for example the time you need to walk to the stop). Leave empty or 0 for the very next departure.
